phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Smartphone Application Processor (SoC) Package refers to the fully assembled and encapsulated semiconductor device that integrates the main processor cores, GPU, memory interfaces, and power management on a single chip, mounted on a substrate with interconnects and external package materials.
